<!-- Code generated from the comments of the Config struct in post-processor/treadmark/post-processor.go; DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY -->

- `mode` (string) - "collect" (default) wraps the provisioner's bundle; "offline"
  captures a baseline host-side from the built image via guestmount +
  `treadmark files init --root` (Linux guest images only).

- `output_dir` (string) - Bundle directory: where the provisioner wrote (collect) or where to
  write (offline). Defaults to treadmark-output/<build name>; must
  match the provisioner's output_dir in collect mode.

- `allow_missing_baseline` (bool) - collect: tolerate a missing baseline.db instead of failing. The
  default failure catches provisioner/post-processor ordering and
  output_dir mismatches.

- `image_path` (string) - offline: image to mount. Defaults to the first *.qcow2 in the input
  artifact's files.

- `config_source` (string) - offline (required): host-side treadmark config (YAML or JSON) with
  the paths/excludes to baseline. The plugin writes a temp copy with
  db_path pointed into output_dir and any report block stripped —
  treadmark has no --db flag, the config is the only way to place the
  DB on the host.

- `treadmark_binary` (string) - offline: treadmark binary on the build host. Default: "treadmark"
  found on PATH.

- `offline_strategy` (string) - offline: capture strategy; only "guestmount" is implemented.

- `libguestfs_backend` (string) - offline: LIBGUESTFS_BACKEND for guestmount (default "direct",
  matching the holy-qcow evidence tooling).

- `extra_env` (map[string]string) - offline: extra environment for guestmount/treadmark. Overrides the
  auto-pinned SUPERMIN_KERNEL / SUPERMIN_MODULES.

- `use_sudo` (bool) - offline: run guestmount/treadmark under sudo (fallback for FUSE
  policy or unreadable kernels).

- `mount_timeout` (duration string | ex: "1h5m2s") - offline: guestmount/guestunmount timeout (default 5m).

- `init_timeout` (duration string | ex: "1h5m2s") - offline: per-treadmark-command timeout (default 30m).

- `skip_verify` (bool) - offline: skip the post-init verification scan.

- `on_drift` (string) - Drift policy for verification scans: "error" (default) or "warn".

- `report_formats` ([]string) - offline: report formats written from the verification scan into
  output_dir (json, ndjson, csv, sarif, md, html, txt).

- `metadata` (map[string]string) - Extra key/value pairs merged into metadata.json "custom"; keys the
  provisioner already recorded win.

- `s3` ([]S3Config) - Optional upload destinations; each s3 block is one bucket.

<!-- End of code generated from the comments of the Config struct in post-processor/treadmark/post-processor.go; -->
